canonicalization: Select canonical_core_fields in listed order; replace missing values with empty string; UTF-8 CSV; comma delimiter; LF line endings; no index.
redistribution_policy: Raw abstracts/export are not committed to GitHub. Only derived bibliographic classifications and hashes are committed.
search_reproducibility_note: The frozen corpus is byte-identifiable and corpus-reproducible, but the exact original Scopus query string that produced the 889-record export is unavailable and is not reconstructed as if exact.
known_original_search_logic: Asymmetric master search combining method-first cardiovascular/arterial temporal-system concepts (including Mori-Zwanzig/generalized Langevin/memory-kernel/Volterra/projection/system-identification terminology) with an ageing-first arterial-ageing temporal/dynamical branch; no year or subject-area limit was reported.
